description: For the person's own booking or service request: waits up to about 25 seconds for something to change (the time being confirmed, payment coming due or being made, a notary being assigned, a live session moving on, the notarized document being ready) and says what changed. Call it once without seen to get the current state and a seen value; call it again with that value to wait. Use it when the person asks to be told as soon as something happens. Needs their private link.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= or t= value from that link

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…) or the status link from a request email (…/requests/SR-…?t=…)

ref.description: Instead of link: the reference, e.g. SR-AB12CD

seen.description: The seen value from the last call (leave out on the first call)

name: wait_for_update
title: Wait for a booking or request to change
